children: Infleqtion achieved 30 entangled logical qubits on its Sqale quantum computer using 80 physical qubits.
Demonstrated entanglement of 30 logical qubits in a single coherent state, validating Sqale architecture.
Used 80 physical qubits to realize 30 logical qubits; experiment produced a signal ~1,000x stronger than noise.
AI-assisted discovery halved the physical gates needed for a key logical operation, reducing error sources.
Infleqtion is on roadmap to 100 logical qubits by 2028 and 1,000 by 2030; presentation slides and technical write-up furnished.
Has three customers for logical qubit circuits and is developing applications including a quantum neural network workflow.
